create_FairseqDropout: create a FairseqDropout module with dropout probability p for standard element-wise dropout in a neural network
create_FairseqFeatureDropout: create a FairseqFeatureDropout module that applies dropout2d to drop entire feature dimensions in sequence data
use_FairseqDropout_forward: use FairseqDropout forward pass to apply element-wise dropout to input tensor x during training
use_FairseqFeatureDropout_forward: use FairseqFeatureDropout forward pass to apply feature-level dropout on 3D tensors with batch_first support
use_make_generation_fast_: use make_generation_fast_ to enable or disable dropout during inference for specific named modules
